instruction: WP3 inbound completeness: (WP3.1) add a regression test that fails if the WASM own-topic subscribe is removed, and fill test gaps around it; (WP3.2) assert that our own topic is never classified as a ghost when our own key is known; (WP3.3) grep every receive path and confirm none passes a payload-only sender_id as the authenticated sender_public_key_hex. Tests first; production only where a gap is proven on current main.
files_touched: core/src/transport/swarm.rs (+178/-21): the auto-subscribe policy is extracted into one pure decision function used by BOTH the native and the wasm32 gossip loop, plus six new tests. No behaviour change.
acceptance: WP3.1: a regression test that fails if the wasm own-topic subscribe is removed -- met by making both loops decide through topic_subscribe_decision and asserting the own-topic decision is Subscribe with no core handle at all
WP3.2: the own topic is never a ghost when the own key is known (and the case-insensitive match holds)
Ghost guard intact: an unproven 64-hex peer topic still fails closed on native
Self-certifying PeerId topics and mesh-wide topics still auto-negotiate
WP3.3: no receive path passes a payload-only sender_id as the authenticated sender

evidence.diff_stat: $ git diff --stat origin/main...HEAD -> core/src/transport/swarm.rs | 199 ++++++--- ; 1 file changed, 178 insertions(+), 21 deletions(-)
evidence.grep_call_sites: $ git grep -n topic_subscribe_decision -- core/src/transport/swarm.rs -> the definition plus ONE match in the native loop and ONE in the wasm loop (both cfg-gated), so neither loop can drift from the other
evidence.wp3_3_audit: $ git grep -n on_message_received( --include=*.rs core/src -> trait decl (iron_core.rs:96), the single production delivery (iron_core.rs:3911), CoreDelegate passthrough (mobile_bridge.rs:2466). receive_message builds sender_public_key_hex from sender_pubkey (verified during decrypt) and stores sender_id: canonical_peer_id derived from it; the plaintext sender_id is not trusted for ingress authorization. No gap.
evidence.ci: CI on the PR head (see the PR for the run URLs). Local tests were not run: python scripts/disk_budget.py reports TIGHT (14.04 GB free of 236.25 GB, 95% used) with nothing reclaimable, and rule 17 makes CI the default verifier.
evidence.rule8: core/src/transport/swarm.rs IS in the gated set. A non-author adversarial APPROVE is REQUIRED before this can be called done; it is outstanding and flagged in the PR body.

canon_rows.canon_identity: untouched: no addressing change; contact identity stays public-key hex.
canon_rows.canon_routing_feed: untouched: the single IronCore::routing_peer_seen entry is not modified or duplicated.
canon_rows.instruction_matches: acceptance rows 1-5 are met: the own-topic removal-regression is real (asserting the decision with no ledger to consult), the ghost guard is pinned in both directions, and WP3.3 is a grep audit that found no gap rather than a speculative rewrite. The honest limit: a unit test can assert the decision, not that a cfg(wasm32) call site still exists -- that is covered by the grep above and by the wasm CI lane compiling the call.

not_claimed: Rule-8 sign-off for core/src/transport/swarm.rs (a non-author reviewer must file the APPROVE).
No 'WiFi fixed' claim: WP5 live 3-node proof is outstanding.
